gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-montagu-sl: SF Wonder Comic stacks dense, tall words with bowls left open on one side, a striking headline voice. And Montagu Slab, a classic serif, handles the quieter work with sturdy downstrokes and a generous x-height.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-esteban: Starborn scatters wide gaps between its letters and lays a dark band of lowercase across each line. Esteban, a serif, counters with thin strokes barely lighter than its stems and an e that stays open.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-faustina: Starborn drifts along with generous space between its letters and a thick, dark band of lowercase. Faustina, a text serif, grounds it with bowls that thin gently and an open-jawed c.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Dreamy, spaced-out and dark. Starborn makes the entrance with its gaping letter gaps, while Hedvig Letters Serif does the steady reading, its sturdy tall lowercase shifting weight like a soft pencil.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-lisu-bosa: A thick, dark stripe of lowercase runs through every line of Starborn, with wide gaps between the letters. Lisu Bosa, a serif, is the one for reading, with sturdy tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-marcellus-sc: Ethereal, spaced-out and strangely heavy. Starborn's wide letter gaps meet Marcellus SC, a classic serif whose gentle stroke modulation and pulled-back terminals feel carved and dignified.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-montagu-slab: Wide gaps between letters and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase make Starborn instantly recognizable. And Montagu Slab, a text serif, follows with sturdy downstrokes, slender turns and an e with an open channel.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Starborn lets its letters drift apart, with a thick dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a serif, moves in with open jaws on its curves and small letters nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-ovo: Widely spaced letters and a thick, dark band of lowercase define Starborn's dreamy look. Ovo, a classic serif, then reads with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and thins only slightly lighter than its thicks.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-domine: Stencilia is structural and striking, with open curve terminals and a tight gap up to the ascenders. Domine, a text serif, softens that with roomy rounded glyphs.
